phases.title: Setup & Lab
phases.tagline: A laptop lab (kind, Docker, free cloud tiers) and your coding agent, ready for every later phase.

phases.title: Linux & Systems
phases.tagline: Processes, files, cgroups, systemd and the kernel interfaces every ops tool is built on.

phases.title: Networking
phases.tagline: Build a resolver, a TCP proxy and a TLS handshake before you configure nginx or Envoy.

phases.title: Git & Collaboration
phases.tagline: A tiny object store and commit graph, then the real Git workflows teams run on.

phases.title: Scripting & Automation
phases.tagline: Bash and Python for operations: idempotent scripts, CLIs, APIs and safe automation.

phases.title: Containers
phases.tagline: Write a container runtime in a few hundred lines, then master Docker, Podman, OCI images and Compose.

phases.title: Orchestration
phases.tagline: A scheduler and a reconciler from scratch, then Kubernetes, Helm, operators and the Gateway API.

phases.title: Infrastructure as Code
phases.tagline: A state file and a plan/apply engine, then Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, Crossplane and Ansible.

phases.title: CI/CD & GitOps
phases.tagline: A pipeline runner and a GitOps reconciler, then GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo CD, Flux and supply-chain security.

phases.title: Cloud Providers
phases.tagline: IAM, networking and compute mental models built by hand, then AWS, Azure and GCP services and certifications.

phases.title: Observability & SRE
phases.tagline: A metrics store, a log pipeline and a tracer, then Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, SLOs and incident response.

phases.title: Security & DevSecOps
phases.tagline: A policy engine and a secrets workflow, then OPA, Kyverno, Falco, Vault and cloud security posture.

phases.title: Platform Engineering
phases.tagline: A golden-path generator, then Backstage, internal developer platforms, DORA metrics and FinOps.

phases.title: AI Infrastructure
phases.tagline: GPU scheduling, model serving with vLLM, KServe and llm-d, AI gateways and the cost of running models.

phases.title: AIOps & Agentic Ops
phases.tagline: MCP servers for your cluster, incident-triage agents, LLM observability, guardrails and evaluations for ops agents.

phases.title: MLOps & LLMOps
phases.tagline: Pipelines, registries, evaluation and rollout for models, for engineers who run the platform.

phases.title: Capstone Projects
phases.tagline: Graded projects: build your own PaaS, an AIOps copilot, a multi-cloud landing zone.

paths.title: DevOps Engineer
paths.description: From a single Linux process to a GitOps-driven platform. The default path if you are not sure where to start.
